questionText:
Consider the following four processes with arrival times (in milliseconds) and their length of CPU bursts (in milliseconds) as shown below:

ProcessP1P2P3P4
Arrival time0134
CPU burst time313Z

These processes are run on a single processor using preemptive Shortest Remaining Time First scheduling algorithm. If the average waiting time of the processes is 1 millisecond, then the value of $Z$ is ________.
explanation:
Step-by-step solution:

1. Given Information:
We have 4 processes scheduled using the preemptive Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF) algorithm.
Total number of processes = $4$.
Average waiting time = $1\text{ ms} \implies$ Total waiting time = $1 \times 4 = 4\text{ ms}$.

2. Execution Analysis:
• At $t = 0$, $P_1$ arrives with burst time $3$ and starts executing.
• At $t = 1$, $P_2$ arrives with burst time $1$. The remaining burst time of $P_1$ is $2$. Since $1 < 2$, $P_2$ preempts $P_1$.
• At $t = 2$, $P_2$ finishes execution.
- Waiting time of $P_2 = \text{Completion Time} - \text{Arrival Time} - \text{Burst Time} = 2 - 1 - 1 = 0\text{ ms}$.
• From $t = 2$ to $t = 3$, $P_1$ resumes execution (remaining burst time becomes $1$).
• At $t = 3$, $P_3$ arrives with burst time $3$. Since remaining time of $P_1 (1) < 3$, $P_1$ continues and completes execution at $t = 4$.
- Waiting time of $P_1 = 4 - 0 - 3 = 1\text{ ms}$.

3. Calculating $Z$:
At $t = 4$, processes $P_1$ and $P_2$ are completed.
Sum of waiting times for $P_1$ and $P_2 = 1 + 0 = 1\text{ ms}$.
Remaining total waiting time for $P_3$ and $P_4 = 4 - 1 = 3\text{ ms}$.

If $Z < 3$, then at $t = 4$, $P_4$ (burst time $Z$) has shorter remaining time than $P_3$ (burst time $3$). Thus, $P_4$ executes first.
• $P_4$ executes from $t = 4$ to $t = 4 + Z$.
- Waiting time of $P_4 = 4 - 4 = 0\text{ ms}$.
• $P_3$ executes from $t = 4 + Z$ to $t = 7 + Z$.
- Completion time of $P_3 = 7 + Z$
- Waiting time of $P_3 = (7 + Z) - 3 - 3 = 1 + Z$.

Sum of waiting times for $P_3$ and $P_4$: $(1 + Z) + 0 = 3 \implies Z = 2$.

Since $Z = 2 < 3$, this condition holds true.

Hence, the value of $Z$ is 2.
